identityBlockers: The values printed as critical temperatures are the recognized triple-point temperatures, not the critical temperatures required by the stated reducing equation.
The article references but does not print the 10 universal Lemmon-Jacobsen departure terms (30 N/d/t values), so their exact version and transcription cannot be checked against author code.
The mapping of each pure-fluid residual Helmholtz function to the mixture reduced variables is not specified sufficiently to prove equivalence with a teqp multifluid construction.
The unavailable Fortran package is required to resolve article/code discrepancies and provide published numerical reference states.
The source package license is unknown and no public package hash can be established.
